description: The dr-egeria Glossary: one term per Dr.Egeria command, with its attributes, used by the dr_egeria_help search tool. A copy of pyegeria's generated help document (gen_dr_help), refreshed by the dr-egeria-command-sync skill. Collection folders are linked with Parent ID and terms with Folders, so a re-run is not proven safe: run it only when the canary is missing.
